character.name: Brennen
character.look: Bulkier tank man, short spiky dark hair, neat goatee, warm confident expressions (vary by card), thick neck and shoulders
character.outfit: Fat dark plate armor with oversized pauldrons, brass buckles, heavy boots, ember-orange accents
character.weapon: One fat ember-glow greatsword only (two-handed). NO dagger, no second weapon.
character.combat_orientation: When shown in combat, faces toward the RIGHT (STS2 left-side fighter convention)
character.sts2_style: Mega Crit STS2 graphic painted: simplified shapes, limited facial detail, chunky brush, strong silhouette

shared_props.fat_greatsword: Wide thick ember-glow greatsword with brass guard and rune edge
shared_props.fat_plate: Heavy dark iron/brass plate pauldrons and breastplate
shared_props.pink_ward: Glowing pink control-ward crystal on a short iron stake
shared_props.cracked_headset: Dark gaming headset with one cracked earcup and ember cracks
shared_props.gold_coin: Thick gold first-blood coin with sword scratch
shared_props.rank_badge: Polished metal ranked badge with small ember star
shared_props.mute_rune: Iron speaker disc with bold black X mute mark

art_rules: Same universe across all cards — reuse props when related cards share motifs
Not every card needs Brennen; prop/effect cards still share palette and props
When Brennen appears: vary pose, expression, and action — not the same stance every time
Tank fantasy: peel, bodyblock, frontline, protect, taunt — keep League meme tone
Landscape card portraits ~1000x760; relics are transparent cutout artifacts only
